RSI(2) pullback with 200 SMA trend filter

Buy short, sharp dips inside an uptrend: long when RSI(2) drops below 10 while price is above its 200 SMA; mirror for shorts. Exit on a close back above the 5 SMA (below for shorts), when RSI(2) recovers, or after 5 bars. 2x ATR stop.

Evidence: Folklore for gold: no gold-specific peer-reviewed evidence found. Popular in equity indices.
